notes: https://ugc.gov.bd/site/view/public_universities and /private_universities now render a 'Frontend/NotFound' page on the redesigned ugc.gov.bd; the UGC lists were read from ugc-universities.gov.bd (UGC's university portal).

Rename: Bangabandhu Sheikh Mujib Medical University (BSMMU) -> Bangladesh Medical University (gazette 16 Apr 2025 per TBS; UGC list and bmu.ac.bd title show the new name; the BMU site still links some bsmmu.edu.bd/bsmmu.ac.bd resources). Same reporting: Sheikh Hasina Medical University -> Khulna Medical University; Bangamata Sheikh Fazilatunnesa Mujib Medical University -> Sylhet Medical University (both appear under new names on the UGC list; not included as entries).

Other UGC public-list entries whose listed domains still carry old acronyms (former names not verified here; not included): Gazipur Agricultural University (gau.edu.bd), Jamalpur Science and Technology University (bsfmstu.ac.bd), Kishoreganj University (bsmru.ac.bd), Khulna Medical University (shmu.ac.bd), Sylhet Medical University (bsfmmu.edu.bd).

Blocked/unreachable sites: www.sust.edu and www.bracu.ac.bd returned HTTP 403 Cloudflare 'Just a moment...' challenge to automated clients (content not readable, name confirmed by UGC only). www.brur.ac.bd (Begum Rokeya University) failed DNS resolution from this environment (curl and WebFetch); name/city rely on UGC only.

Website differences vs UGC list: IUB - UGC lists www.iub.edu.bd; http://www.iub.edu.bd redirects to https://iub.ac.bd (title 'Independent University, Bangladesh'). USTC - UGC lists www.ustc.edu.bd, which does not resolve; https://ustc.ac.bd loads (title 'University of Science and Technology Chittagong (USTC)'; returns 406 without browser headers). AIUB - UGC lists www.aiub.ac.bd, which did not load; https://www.aiub.edu loads (title 'Home | AIUB').

Minor spelling differences: CUET site title uses 'Chittagong University of Engineering and Technology'; USTC site uses 'and' not '&'. UGC spellings kept as name_en. 'city' uses current spellings (Chattogram, Cumilla, Bogura, Barishal) whereas some UGC addresses still say 'Chittagong'.

name_bn filled only where the official site shows the full name verbatim and uninflected (title, header, or parenthetical); otherwise null. BAUST Bangla string comes from a site news item quoting the full name; it omits the 'Saidpur' suffix.

UGC private-list flags on excluded institutions: e.g., Global University Bangladesh and University of Skill Enrichment and Technology barred from new admissions from Jan 2026; People's University and Victoria University flagged '*'. None of the included private universities carry a flag.
No private university in Mymensingh division was included; Mymensingh coverage is public only (BAU, JKKNIU).
